entries.migration_impact: Documentation only. Teams running the #1338 pilot should follow the new protocol; no code or workflow changes.
entries.agent_notes: Closes design scope for #1353. Win metric is all-in cost per accepted outcome with escaped defects no worse; ~20 pairs are directional; ~30-76 pairs needed for a strong 30% cost claim.
migration_guidance: 1. Read docs/design/agent-crews-pilot-protocol.md before scheduling pilot runs.
2. Record spend with gh plate ledger --record-spend and attribute runs with gh plate costs --run-cost; never invent token or cost values.
3. On DentalCoach use paired-arm comparison only; do not claim a merged-PR historical baseline.

entries.migration_impact: Adopters may add .agentic/tasks/*.yml crew specs and run gh plate tasks validate locally; no workflow or label changes.
entries.agent_notes: Task specs extend the #395 delegation packet with typed IO, model tiers, tool allow-lists, and static next edges. Role may be inferred from issue type/labels at runtime; validate with tasks validate.
migration_guidance: 1. Copy examples from src/plate_core/data/examples/ into .agentic/tasks/ when piloting agent crews.
2. Run gh plate tasks validate (or python -m plate_core.task_spec) before committing task specs.
3. Reference MCP tool profile names from tool_profiles.py in tools.profiles; level and route stay in the YAML, not GitHub labels.

entries.migration_impact: After import-payload or self-migrate, open AGENTS.md for the core contract and follow links to docs/agents/ for ceremony, babysit, autonomy, and script detail. No behavioral intent change.
entries.agent_notes: Load docs/agents/<topic>.md when work touches that topic; the core index table lists each page.

entries.migration_impact: New repositories bootstrapped with plate-core after this change show a single grouped scaffold commit on the default branch (plus the existing optional initial README commit on empty repos). Stale-skip reporting and label sync behavior are unchanged.
entries.agent_notes: When reviewing bootstrap history on a repo, expect one commit titled "Bootstrap: initialize PLATE template payload" for scaffold files rather than dozens of per-path commits. Re-run bootstrap still skips identical and stale remote paths per #1257.

entries.surface: gh plate ci audit + plate_core.ci_audit + docs/design/ci-audit-command.md
entries.migration_impact: Additive CLI only. Adopters run `gh plate ci audit [--limit N] [--json]` against their repo; no workflow or branch-protection changes.
entries.agent_notes: Workflow motivation credited in docs to Owen Gretzinger's Oct 2026 X post on Boardy CI analysis (see issue #1282); PLATE heuristics and output are original. Complements research #1271 and feeds future nightly audit procedures under #1268.
migration_guidance: Ensure `gh` is authenticated with Actions read access for the target repository.
Run `gh plate ci audit --json` locally or from a scheduled procedure when baselining CI minutes.
Read docs/design/ci-audit-command.md for setup/test step heuristics before acting on numbers.

entries.migration_impact: Bootstrapped repos receive `.agentic/skills/ci-audit/SKILL.md` on import-payload. The CI speed checklist links to the skill; no baseline catalog or workflow changes.
entries.agent_notes: Lazy-load `.agentic/skills/ci-audit/SKILL.md` only for CI speed or minutes baselining work—not for ordinary feature loops. Measure with `gh plate ci audit [--json]`; treat cache hint_* fields as name-based guesses.
migration_guidance: Run `gh plate import-payload` (or bootstrap) to copy `.agentic/skills/ci-audit/SKILL.md`.
When improving CI speed, read the skill from docs/migration/ci-speed-checklist.md before baselining minutes.
Requires `gh plate` with the ci audit command (#1282); see docs/design/ci-audit-command.md in plate-core for heuristics.

entries.migration_impact: Optional read for adopters reshaping CI; no workflow import required. Sync the doc via gh plate import-payload when upgrading plate-core.
entries.agent_notes: PLATES-CORE block id ci-cd-split-heavy-jobs holds sync-safe bullet guidance. actions-cost-rollout link points at akasper/plate main (not in default payload). Do not edit the separate CI speed checklist page for #1283.
migration_guidance: Read docs/migration/ci-cd-split-guidance.md before removing OS matrices or installer jobs from PR workflows.
Keep branch protection on labels, test, and pr-gates; do not require check names from workflows that do not run on every pull_request (pending checks block merges).
Job-level if: skips satisfy required checks; workflow-level filters that skip the whole workflow do not.
Run post-merge or release pipelines after integration merges to catch platform-specific regressions.

entries.migration_impact: Optional: adopters enable path selection by adding config and wiring plate-select-ci-jobs; required checks labels, test, and pr-gates stay unchanged with an aggregate test job pattern.
entries.agent_notes: Regression: tests/test_ci_path_jobs.py. Helper exits 1 on safety fail. PLATE_CI_FULL_SUITE or --full-suite selects all jobs. Credits in docs/migration/ci-path-job-selection.md.
migration_guidance: 1. Copy .agentic/ci-path-jobs.example.yml to .agentic/ci-path-jobs.yml and set enabled: true with your modules and all_jobs list.
2. Add a select job using .github/actions/plate-select-ci-jobs; gate optional jobs with jobs_json / run_all outputs.
3. Keep job ids labels, test (aggregate), and pr-gates for branch protection; optional jobs may skip but aggregate test must pass.
4. Add plate-ci-scheduled-full-suite.example.yml (or equivalent) on main with full-suite: true for nightly coverage.

entries.surface: docs/migration/ci-speed-checklist.md + template_payload copy + PLATES-CORE block ci-speed-checklist-1283
entries.migration_impact: New optional doc at docs/migration/ci-speed-checklist.md. Adopters on import-payload receive the same file under template paths; merge the PLATES-CORE block if they customized a fork of the page.
entries.agent_notes: When improving CI speed, follow docs/migration/ci-speed-checklist.md; measure with gh plate ci audit (#1282) and track minutes (#1272). Idea themes credited to Owen Gretzinger's Oct 2026 X post, summarized in the doc.
migration_guidance: 1. Pull or run gh plate import-payload to copy docs/migration/ci-speed-checklist.md.
2. Link the page from your operator index if you maintain a local docs README.
3. Apply checklist items in your own workflows; PLATE required gates (labels, test, pr-gates) stay unchanged.

entries.migration_impact: Adopters should read docs/copilot-review.md and set repository Copilot code review Review effort level to Lite in GitHub Settings; use Balanced only when requesting review on high-risk PRs.
entries.agent_notes: Default effort is UI-only on GitHub; PLATE does not add doctor/adopt verification until a read API exists. Pair with agents/github-actions-and-copilot.md for when to request Copilot at all.
migration_guidance: 1. Open repository Settings → Copilot → Code review and set Review effort level to Lite (organization default optional).
2. When requesting Copilot review on PRs labeled risk:high or risk:critical, choose Balanced for that request only.
3. No gh plate import-payload or workflow change is required; verify manually because GitHub does not expose the default effort level via REST/GraphQL read APIs.

entries.migration_impact: New greenfield bootstraps after this change include CURRENT.md on the default branch without a separate import-payload step. Existing repos with CURRENT.md are unchanged (bootstrap skips the path).
entries.agent_notes: Seed Epic milestone attachment for label-check was already handled by `_resolve_bootstrap_epic_milestone_number` and create-initial-epic apply logic; this fragment covers the missing CURRENT.md half of #1322.

entries.migration_impact: Additive optional fields on spend_interval JSON. New MCP tool plate_ledger_record_jev. Existing ledger rows unchanged.
entries.agent_notes: Shadow only: no router or tier logic may consume jev_score. lifecycle_task_type should reflect non-dev work when applicable.
migration_guidance: 1. After a run, record applied routing via --record-spend or plate_ledger_record_spend.
2. Record Jev opinion via gh plate ledger --record-jev-score --run-id <id> --jev-score <n> (optional jev_suggested_tier, jev_model, jev_route_clarity).
3. Do not branch routing on jev_* until shadow evaluation completes (60 labeled runs).

migration_guidance: Sync `.github/workflows/label-check.yml` and the PR label gate (`.github/workflows/ci.yml` labels job in the template; `.github/workflows/labels.yml` in plate-core) from upstream.
Optional: add `tier:T0`..`tier:T3` to `.github/labels.yml` when you adopt crew routing labels.

entries.migration_impact: Task specs that violate the level/tier band or junior docs/tests start rules fail gh plate tasks validate. Pass issue_labels when validating dispatch tied to risk:critical issues.
entries.agent_notes: Policy matches agent-crews.md #1327 decisions. No new GitHub labels beyond optional tier:T0-T3.
migration_guidance: 1. Keep model_policy.tiers within the allowed set for each level (see level_tier_policy_table() or router design doc).
2. Set start_tier to the mapped initial tier for the level; set acceptance.ci_validates_output: true on junior docs/tests tasks when CI checks output, then start at the cheapest listed tier.
3. When routing from risk:critical issues, set approval to human-t3 or stronger.

entries.migration_impact: Adopters who customized marketing.yml should merge the new ai_discoverability block and update source_of_product_truth from CURRENT.md to SPEC.md when refreshing from payload.

Add the ai_discoverability block under claim_review_policy when enabling Epic #1159 visibility checks; keep enabled: false until engines and caps are chosen.
Point prompt_set at your prompt-set file (template default: docs/marketing/ai-discoverability/prompt-set.md once #1161 lands).

entries.migration_impact: MCP hosts now receive a smaller default tools/list unless PLATE_MCP_TOOL_PROFILES or --tool-profiles includes additional profiles or all. gh plate and CLI behavior are unchanged.
entries.agent_notes: Default MCP attachment uses the default profile alias (~20 tools). Use profile all for exhaustive tool-list tests or full-surface sessions.

2. For specialized agents, enable only the profiles you need (see docs/mcp.md).
3. Task specs may reference profile names in tool allow-lists as they land under Epic #1327.

3. Role routing from issues continues to use issue type plus existing labels; do not add role:* labels.

entries.migration_impact: Adopters should import updated PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md and plate-pr-gates.yml; fill Agent review models table on new PRs.
entries.agent_notes: Parse the Agent review models table in the PR body. Warn-only by default; `--enforce` makes a missing table or same normalized model id fail. Same provider with different models always warns only.
migration_guidance: 1. Run gh plate import-payload (dry-run, then apply) for plate-pr-gates.yml and PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md, or regenerate gates with scripts/build_plate_pr_gates_workflow.py after upgrading plate-core.
2. Fill Author model and Reviewer model in every Feature/Bug/Documentation PR; use copilot for GitHub Copilot code review when the author was an agent model.
3. Human merge approval requirements are unchanged; this gate is warn-only for now and will block identical author/reviewer model ids in a later release.

4. Payload plate-pr-gates tries PYTHONPATH, an existing plate-core install, or pip install of the pinned plate-core version in that workflow; if the runtime is still unavailable the step warns and continues (warn-only rollout).

entries.migration_impact: Additive ledger record_type spend_interval and plate_ledger_record_spend MCP tool. plate_costs / gh plate costs gain spend_report and run_cost modes. Existing decision ledger JSON loads unchanged.

migration_guidance: 1. Callers record intervals via plate_ledger_record_spend or gh plate ledger --record-spend (pass only measured fields).
2. Pilot attribution: gh plate costs --spend-report or plate_costs spend_report=true.
3. One run all-in: gh plate costs --run-cost --run-id <id> or plate_costs run_cost=true.

2. Copy .agentic/ci-policy.example.yml to .agentic/ci-policy.yml; set enabled: true and job_sizes from measured runs.
3. Pass --pr-kind ordinary or release_patch|release_minor|release_major from Release metadata; use nightly for scheduled full suite.
4. Wire select_tiered_ci_jobs in CI only after owner approval; keep aggregate test job pattern from ci-path-job-selection.md.
